items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And I'm Dick Allen is my name.

ctx.x: Either that or perhaps he had a trumpet, the bell of the trumpet in his ear. That has affected me at times. I'll just hear a big echo and don't count it in.

Well, we never did put our names on here. Not Paul Crawford. You were saying your ear is stocked up. This can affect you playing, things like that. And I'm Dick Allen is my name. Put your name on that, Paul.
I coughed my name onto the tape.
